criterion: Accepts recorded clips through an injectable frame source
notes: Yes / no / screen-replay fallback only. A refusal is a finding, not a footnote — score it.

criterion: SDK version and build recorded for this run
notes: Not scored for quality; fill it in so the row is reproducible. Include OS version and device.

criterion: Time to first successful integration (engineer-days)
notes: Your own measured effort, not the vendor's quickstart estimate.

criterion: Per-clip rep precision — fair clips
notes: Share of counted reps that really happened. Per clip, never pooled. Report separately from recall.

criterion: Per-clip rep recall — fair clips
notes: Share of real reps that were counted. Under-counting is the complaint users write down.

criterion: Per-clip rep precision — known-hard clips
notes: Clips deliberately outside the documented operating envelope. Track as trend; do not let them gate.

criterion: Per-clip rep recall — known-hard clips
notes: Same clips as the row above. Report both directions or a compensating error hides.

criterion: False positives on non-rep clips
notes: Abandoned reps, clothing adjustment, re-gripping, racking. Expected count: zero.

criterion: False positives on the negative clip
notes: Person visible and moving, not exercising. Expected count: zero. Cheapest clip in the corpus.

criterion: Behaviour with a second person or mirror in frame
notes: Does the tracker switch skeletons? Does the count jump? Note the failure mode, not just pass/fail.

criterion: Behaviour at the worst plausible camera angle
notes: Graceful degradation or an explicit refusal both pass. Counting confidently and wrongly fails.

criterion: Cue fires on the staged deviation
notes: Per exercise, per deviation you filmed. Correctness only — latency is the next row.

criterion: Cue stays silent on a clean rep
notes: False-positive rate for coaching cues. A chatty coach is an uninstalled coach.

criterion: Cue latency after the movement (ms)
notes: A correct cue two seconds late is a cue about a rep the user already finished.

criterion: Cue text is usable in your product without rewriting
notes: Wording, tone, localisation. Judgement call — record the reasoning in this cell.

criterion: Time to first tracking from cold start (ms)
notes: Measure on your worst target device, not your best. Conversion metric in performance clothing.

criterion: p95 frame latency — pass 1 of the soak
notes: Baseline for the drift row below. Emit the per-frame CSV as a build artifact.

criterion: Thermal soak drift — p95 latency pass 8 vs pass 1
notes: Eight back-to-back passes of one 3-minute clip, cold start, screen on, no charger.

criterion: Thermal soak drift — rep count pass 8 vs pass 1
notes: A count that changes as the silicon throttles. No container can produce this number.

criterion: Offline behaviour in airplane mode
notes: Graceful degradation, queue, hang, or blank screen. Observe and note; weight only if your users train offline.

criterion: Result consistency across the three device classes
notes: A vendor that only works on your newest phone has not passed.

criterion: Current pricing and the unit it scales on
notes: Per active user / session / device / inference-minute. The unit decides your cost curve, not the number.

criterion: On-device or edge processing guarantee for YOUR configuration
notes: Written, configuration-specific. Treat words like 'optional edge processing' as a question, not an answer.

criterion: Model update cadence and advance notice
notes: A model bump moves keypoints, which moves your thresholds. Ask whether you can pin a version.

criterion: SLA and behaviour during service degradation
notes: Especially relevant where the camera experience is hosted rather than in-process.

criterion: Data retention: what is stored, where, and for how long
notes: Video versus derived events only. Route through your compliance owner before the trial, not after.

criterion: Exit terms: export, content ownership, notice period
notes: What you can take with you and how much warning ends the contract.

criterion: Shipped exercise and content library needed?
notes: Scope match, not a quality signal. Scoring this rewards vendors shaped like a particular buyer.

criterion: White-label theming needed?
notes: Or are you consuming raw events into your own UI?

criterion: Platform coverage required at parity
notes: iOS, Android, web, React Native, Flutter. Verify parity in the trial rather than from a table.

criterion: Native SDK or embedded hosted experience
notes: Decides how much of the pixel-level experience you own. Neither shape is wrong.

criterion: Consumer or clinical/rehab scope
notes: Paying for clinical scope you do not need is as much a mismatch as lacking it when you do.
